title: Vibrant Mexican Rhubarb Rajas Con Crema
description: A salty and bouncy Mexican dish featuring forced rhubarb, this recipe is a crowd pleaser and can be served at any meal, it is also buddhist temple friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the rhubarb and onion with the tagine spice mix until they are evenly coated.
Spread the rhubarb mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the rhubarb is roasting, heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the garlic, cook for 1 minute.
Add the crema to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic.
Once the rhubarb is done roasting, add it to the skillet with the crema and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the rajas by spooning the rhubarb mixture onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the rajas con crema hot, wrapped in a lotus leaf if desired.
